info.title: Flung API
info.description: Schedule, publish and automate social media posts.

apiKey.description: An API key (flung_sk_...), an OAuth access token from Flung's authorization server (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server), or, for the few calls a connect panel makes, a connect token (flung_ct_...).

profileId.description: The profile the post was made for, or null.

publishAtLocal.description: The same instant as the local time in `timeZone`, with its offset.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of `publishAtLocal`: the one the time was given in, or the caller's for a post from before zones were kept.

warnings.description: Only when creating or changing a post: how a local `publishAt` that the clocks skip or repeat was read.

TimeWarning.description: A local time that did not name exactly one instant, and how it was read.

profileId.description: The profile the post was made for, or null.

publishAtLocal.description: The same instant as the local time in `timeZone`, with its offset.

timeZone.description: The IANA zone of `publishAtLocal`: the one the time was given in, or the caller's for a post from before zones were kept.

displayName.description: The name the platform shows for the account (a person, page, channel), when it gave one at connect time.

avatarUrl.description: The account's picture on the platform, an https address, as it was at connect time. Show it with `referrerpolicy="no-referrer"`.

profileId.description: The profile the account belongs to, or null for the workspace as a whole.

status.description: `needs_reconnect`: the platform refused the token; start a reconnect.

renewal.description: `automatic`: Flung refreshes the token before it expires, until `reconnectBy` if set. `manual`: only a reconnect renews it, by `reconnectBy`. `not_needed`: the token does not expire.

tokenExpiresAt.description: When the current access token expires. Flung renews `automatic` ones about a day before.

reconnectBy.description: The last moment the account works without a reconnect; null when it renews indefinitely. Flung sends `account.reconnect_required_soon` a week before.

defaultBoard.description: Pinterest only: where pins go unless a post picks another board.

enabled.description: Whether comments and mentions are read. null is the platform's default: on, except X, where reading costs money.

error.description: Why the last read failed, such as a missing permission.

inbox.description: Reading comments and mentions into GET /v1/inbox.

result.description: `refreshed`: a new token is stored. `not_needed`: this account has nothing to refresh. `reconnect_required`: the platform refused; the account is now `needs_reconnect`. `failed`: a temporary platform failure; try again later.

privacyLevels.description: The audiences this account may post to now; pass one as platformOverrides.tiktok.privacyLevel.

commentsDisabled.description: The creator turned comments off; posts cannot allow them.

plan.description: The plan: free, pro ($19 a month) or business ($59 a month).

source.description: Where the plan comes from: no subscription, a paying Stripe subscription, or set by Flung.

status.description: The subscription's Stripe status, or none.

usage.description: What counts against each limit now.

upgradeUrl.description: The workspace's Plan page on the Flung portal, where an owner upgrades.

accounts.description: Connected social accounts that are not disconnected.

postsPerMonth.description: Posts created in one UTC calendar month; a post counts once however many accounts it goes to.

requestsPerMinute.description: Requests a minute for each API key, OAuth app or connect token.

accountsPerPlatformPerProfile.description: Live accounts of one platform in one profile, the accounts outside every profile counting as one profile; a LinkedIn page counts apart from a LinkedIn profile. Across the workspace a platform also has at most this times `profiles`. A second is refused with `platform_limit_reached`. null is no limit.

secret.description: The signing secret (Standard Webhooks, `whsec_...`). Shown only in this response; store it now.
The new signing secret. Shown only in this response.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until then, deliveries carry signatures from both secrets.

eventType.description: An event type, or `webhook.ping` for a test.

token.description: Hand this to the page (`<flung-connect token>`). It can only list, connect, reconnect and disconnect accounts.

accountId.description: The account being reconnected; null for a new connection.

status.description: `pending` until the person finishes on the platform; `expired` when they did not by `expiresAt`.

authorizationUrl.description: Send the person here: the platform's own consent page. Null once the session has ended.

expiresAt.description: The person must finish by then.

accountIds.description: The accounts stored, once `connected`. Facebook connects one per page.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to tell keys apart.

key.description: The secret key. Shown only in this response; store it now.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to tell keys apart.

userId.description: The person who approved the app, for an OAuth token; null for an API key.

plan.description: The plan: free, pro ($19 a month) or business ($59 a month).

timeZone.description: The IANA zone a local `publishAt` without `timeZone` is read in: the person's for an OAuth token, else the workspace's default, else UTC.

timeZoneSource.description: Where `timeZone` came from: the person's profile, the workspace's default, or neither (UTC).

nowLocal.description: The time now in `timeZone`, with its offset.

role.description: `owner` may add and remove members; both may connect apps to the workspace.

uploadUrl.description: For a file up to 100 MB: PUT it here, with your credential and its Content-Length. Null for a multipart upload.

partSize.description: Every part but the last is exactly this many bytes.

partUrl.description: PUT each part to this address with `{partNumber}` replaced by 1 to partCount, in any order.

completeUrl.description: POST here once every part is in.

multipart.description: For a file over 100 MB: how to send it in parts.

MediaType.description: What the file really is, read from its first bytes once uploaded.

altText.description: The alt text the file was imported with, such as a Plotwork diagram's name. Null for an upload.

status.description: `pending` until its bytes arrive; `ready` once a post can use it.
`skipped` when the video is over 100 MB or this month's thumbnail allowance is used up. Posts never wait for a preview; they use the file as uploaded.

thumbnailUrl.description: A JPEG frame one second in, 640 pixels wide, at an address that does not expire.

hlsUrl.description: Always null for now: streaming versions are not made.

preview.description: Videos only, where previews are set up: a thumbnail. Read the file again while `processing`.

template.description: The post text: `{{title}}`, `{{link}}`, `{{summary}}` from each item, and workspace variables.

connectable.description: Whether this Flung has the platform's app credentials, so accounts can be connected.

variants.description: The connect variants set up here, to pass as `variant` when connecting: LinkedIn's `pages` connects company pages.

connectFlow.description: How a connect ends. `consent`: the `authorizationUrl` is a sign-in page that sends the person back to `redirectUrl`. `approval` (Farcaster): it opens the platform's phone app to approve Flung, nothing comes back to `redirectUrl`, and the session finishes when it is read, so show the link (or a QR code of it) and poll `GET /v1/connect-sessions/{id}`.

maxImages.description: Images in one post; 0 when images are not accepted.

postsPerHour.description: How fast Flung publishes to one account, to stay inside the platform's limits.

tokensExpire.description: Whether connections expire; Flung renews them before they do where the platform allows.

destinations.description: Posts go to a destination chosen per post (Pinterest boards).

rank.description: 1 is the platform's best slot of the week.

errors.description: Answers of 400 or more, rate limits included.

posts.description: Posts due in the window, by status.

targets.description: Publishes to accounts on this platform, by status.

kind.description: `comment`: a reply to one of the account's posts. `mention`: the account named elsewhere.

targetId.description: The Flung post target it answers, when that post went out through Flung.

metrics.description: null when the platform has no counts for Flung, or could not be read now (see `error`).

streakDays.description: Days in a row with a published post, up to today or yesterday.

leaderboardName.description: The name on the public leaderboard; null when the workspace is not on it.

unlockedAt.description: When Flung first saw it earned.

status.description: `needs_reconnect` once Plotwork ended the grant: a person connects it again in the portal. Null when not connected.

organisation.description: The Plotwork organisation whose library it reads, or null for the person's own.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

scheme.description: The color scheme it was drawn in, such as light, dark or auto.

updatedAt.description: When it was last published in Plotwork.

post.description: Schedules one post to one or more connected accounts. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retry never posts twice. `publishAt` may be the local time a person said, such as `2026-11-03T09:00`, with `timeZone`: Flung converts it to UTC, and answers with `publishAt` in UTC, `publishAtLocal` and the `timeZone` it used.

schema.description: Any unique string, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours gets the first answer instead of running again.

parameters.description: Any unique string, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours gets the first answer instead of running again.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

accountIds.description: The connected accounts to publish to.

publishAt.description: When to publish. Either an instant with Z or an offset (`2026-11-03T07:00:00Z`, `2026-11-03T09:00:00+02:00`), or the local time a person said, without an offset (`2026-11-03T09:00`), which Flung reads in `timeZone`. A local time the clocks skip moves forward by the gap, and one they pass twice takes the earlier instant; either adds a `warnings` entry. Omit to publish now.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Athens`. Without one, a local `publishAt` is read in the zone of the person behind an OAuth token, else the workspace's default (GET /v1/me says which), else UTC. A zone that is not IANA is refused with `invalid_time_zone`.

publishAt.description: When to publish. Either an instant with Z or an offset (`2026-11-03T07:00:00Z`, `2026-11-03T09:00:00+02:00`), or the local time a person said, without an offset (`2026-11-03T09:00`), which Flung reads in `timeZone`. A local time the clocks skip moves forward by the gap, and one they pass twice takes the earlier instant; either adds a `warnings` entry. Omit to publish now.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Athens`. Without one, a local `publishAt` is read in the zone of the person behind an OAuth token, else the workspace's default (GET /v1/me says which), else UTC. A zone that is not IANA is refused with `invalid_time_zone`.
